blocks.x: Created under **Article 312** by a Rajya Sabha resolution supported by **two-thirds present and voting**, in the national interest.
blocks.th: Constitutional design; Sardar Patel's steel frame.
blocks.in: **IAS, IPS and Indian Forest Service (1966)**; the **All India Judicial Service** proposed since the 14th Law Commission Report and never created.
blocks.gl: No other federation has a joint cadre of this kind.
blocks.w: The AIS is the **institutional spine of Indian federalism** — and, to critics, an instrument of central influence.

blocks.x: Officers are recruited centrally, allotted to state cadres, and drawn to the Centre on deputation.
blocks.th: **IAS (Cadre) Rules, 1954**; Central Deputation Reserve; cadre review cycle.
blocks.in: The proposed **2022 amendment to Rule 6** allowing the Centre to call officers without state concurrence — read by states as an attack on the federal bargain.
blocks.w: Falling deputation numbers versus federal consent is an **unresolved live dispute**.

blocks.x: Merit through open competition, insulated by constitutional design.
blocks.th: **Articles 315-323** — removal only on a Supreme Court reference (317), post-retirement bar (319), expenses charged on the Consolidated Fund (322), annual report with reasons for non-acceptance (323).
blocks.in: Kothari (1976) scheme; **Baswan (2016)** found intake of ~180 IAS a year cannot close a deficit of 1,300+.
blocks.gl: Civil service commissions in the Commonwealth.
blocks.w: UPSC's advice is **advisory but explained** — the memorandum requirement is what makes it work.

blocks.x: Induction, professional and mid-career training, now competency-based.
blocks.th: **FRAC** model under Mission Karmayogi; National Training Policy 2012.
blocks.in: **LBSNAA**, SVPNPA, IGNFA, ISTM, NIRDPR, IIPA; **Aarambh** common foundation course; iGOT with 1 crore+ registrations and 3 crore completions.
blocks.gl: Singapore Civil Service College; France's INSP.
blocks.w: The test is whether **FRAC changes posting decisions**, not whether courses are completed.

blocks.x: Whether senior policy posts should be filled by career generalists alone.
blocks.th: **Fulton (1968)**; Second ARC and NITI on lateral entry.
blocks.in: From 2018 at Joint Secretary, Director and Deputy Secretary level; ~60+ appointments; the **2024 advertisement withdrawn** over absence of reservation in single-post recruitment.
blocks.gl: Political appointees in the US; open competition in the UK SCS.
blocks.w: The unresolved question is whether lateral entry can coexist with **constitutional reservation**.

blocks.x: Transfers, postings and sanction decisions are where interference actually operates.
blocks.th: **T.S.R. Subramanian (2013)** — Civil Services Board, minimum tenure, **written orders**.
blocks.in: Khemka's 50+ transfers; Durga Shakti Nagpal's suspension; partial state compliance.
blocks.w: Fixed tenure is a **systemic remedy** for what is otherwise treated as personal courage.

blocks.t: Performance and accountability of civil servants
blocks.x: Appraisal, empanelment, and the rarely used route of compulsory retirement.
blocks.th: **Surinder Nath (2003)**; Second ARC's two intensive reviews at 14 and 20 years.
blocks.in: PAR with disclosure and 360-degree input; **FR 56(j)** compulsory retirement in public interest; rating inflation blunting differentiation.
blocks.gl: Up-or-out systems in the US foreign service.
blocks.w: Where nearly everyone is 'outstanding', promotion **reverts to seniority**.

blocks.x: Conduct rules prescribe; ethics codes aspire — India is heavy on the first, light on the second.
blocks.th: **AIS (Conduct) Rules, 1968**; **CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964**; Second ARC's proposed **Public Services Bill** and code of ethics.
blocks.in: Gift limits, property transactions, bar on public criticism of policy, asset disclosure.
blocks.w: A code of conduct enumerates; a **code of ethics gives a reason** — India needs the second.

blocks.t: Women and diversity in the services
blocks.x: Composition shapes what an institution notices.
blocks.th: **Representative bureaucracy** — Kingsley, Krislov; passive versus active representation.
blocks.in: Women about a third of recent IAS batches but a smaller share of senior policy posts; ~12% of the police against a declared 33%; reservation as the largest such experiment anywhere.
blocks.w: Representation is an **effectiveness argument**, not only a fairness one.

blocks.x: India is, by international comparison, a **small state** — not a bloated one.
blocks.in: ~1,600 central government employees per lakh population against roughly four times that in the US; **32 lakh central civilian employees against ~40 lakh sanctioned**; IAS sanctioned 6,858, in position ~5,500.
blocks.w: The problem is **distribution and capacity at the cutting edge**, not aggregate numbers.

blocks.x: Compensation as hygiene, career design as motivator.
blocks.in: **7th CPC** pay matrix; 8th CPC announced; **Unified Pension Scheme (2025)** — assured 50% of last 12 months' average after 25 years, a partial return to defined benefit after NPS (2004).
blocks.w: Pension design is **motivation and fiscal liability at once**.

blocks.x: Association is permitted; **strike is not a right**.
blocks.in: **Joint Consultative Machinery and Compulsory Arbitration (1966)**; service associations as the recognised channel.
blocks.w: Denial of strike is defensible **only if the negotiating machinery works**.
